title: Result of an extension update check — update_result
text: Properties: available Logical scalar. TRUE newer version extension known exist. Defaults FALSE, safe default: forgotten field produce spurious update prompt. current Character scalar. installed version extension, NA_character_ determined. latest Character scalar. latest available version, NA_character_ determined. news_url Character scalar. optional URL pointing changelog release notes show alongside update prompt; use NA_character_ (default) none available. Consistent current latest, NA represents "absent". Validation enforced class: invalid construction errors call site. framework wraps construction error handling (see validate_update_check_result()), misbehaving extension crash app — downgraded safe "update" result warning.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: shinyDashboard() launches application. Also available RStudio “Addins” menu “Neuropsychological Test Result Dashboard”. Multi-panel layout built bslib Bootstrap 5. Per-participant view study ID selector, demographics table, visit-date selector. Asynchronous data loading extension data (e.g. biomarkers) via mirai daemons, UI stays responsive extensions fetch data background.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: Built-CSV upload source (csv_source) files NACC format. Built-Demo source (demo_source) loads ntrs::demo_data derived variables (REYTOTAL, REYAREC, FAS, MOCACLOCK) pre-computed — useful trying app without real data. data_nacc S7 class validates input data construction: checks required columns (NACCID, SEX, EDUC, BIRTHYR), enforces column types, validates SEX visit-date values, auto-derives VISITDATE NACCAGE components present.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: Third parties can register new data sources declaring Config/ntrd/extension: true DESCRIPTION providing S7 methods data_source_ui(), data_source_server(), data_load(). new_data_source() constructor defining class inherits data_source. discover_data_sources() scans installed packages app startup populates data-source dropdown. Extensions can ship additional UI panels reactive helpers via extras channel returned data_source_server(). Extensions can optionally provide restore function previously entered configuration (e.g. API tokens) can repopulated. Conflict detection warns multiple extensions define std_using_* generics name. Full walkthrough available “Extension API” vignette, ntrdWisconsin complete worked example.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: assessment_summary_table() / mainTableModule — main per-visit NACC T-Cog assessment summary table, rendered gt. assessment_longitudinal_table() / longTableModule — longitudinal table scores across visits. demographics_table() — compact gt demographics summary flagging missing visit--visit-varying values. prev_diagnoses_table() / prevDiagnosesModule — prior diagnoses table. plotModule — interactive plotly longitudinal trend plots, one accordion panel per cognitive domain, crosswalk pairs colored consistently trace-visibility state surfaced back Shiny. “Generate PDF Download” button main table (requires pagedown); falls back friendly install hint pagedown isn’t available.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: descriptionsModule — interactive table editing score-region labels, upper-bound cutoffs, fill colors. Rows can added, edited, reordered (upper bound), removed, reset defaults. Sidebar option toggle shading plots according descriptions. Sidebar slider adjust main-table font size. “Setup” tab (methodSelectModule) choosing standardization methods assigning variables cognitive domains; defaults auto-applied available, notification pointing Setup tab customization.

title: ntrd 0.0.1
text: check_extension_update() calls extension’s exported ntrd_update_available() (cached one hour default; configurable via ttl); clear_update_cache() invalidates cache. Update banner appears header newer version active extension published, “’s new?” link extension’s NEWS.md provided. Two-stage restart cascade (install one restart, relaunch next) RStudio users; clear manual install instructions modal Positron, plain R, Rscript, VS Code R extension, restart--command flow isn’t supported. update_result S7 class formalizes contract extensions framework; validate_update_check_result() gracefully downgrades malformed results safe “update” state instead crashing app. default_github_update_available() default_github_update_extension() factories provide ready--use implementations GitHub-hosted extensions.
